newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - FAYETTEVILLE-MANLIUS CSD, N.Y..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - FAYETTEVILLE-MANLIUS CSD, N.Y..

text.p: Onondaga and Madison Counties, New York

Sealed proposals will be received and considered by the undersigned Chief Fiscal Officer of Fayetteville-Manlius Central School District, Onondaga and Madison Counties, New York, at the Office of Fleet Securities, Inc., 67 Wall Street, New York, New York, 10005, until 11:00 A.M., Prevailing Time,

at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the purchase IN FEDERAL FUNDS at not less than par and accrued interest of $9,091,000 School District (Serial) Bonds, 1997, of said School District, dated August 15, 1997, maturing on June 15 in the amount of $521,000 in the year 1998, $515,000 in each of the years 1999 to 2001, both inclusive, $550,000 in the year 2002, $575,000 in the year 2003, $600,000 in each of the years 2004 to 2006, both inclusive, $650,000 in each of the years 2007 to 2008, both inclusive, and $700,000 in the years 2009 to 2012, both inclusive, with interest thereon payable on June 15 1998 and semi-annually thereafter on December 15 and June 15 in each maturity.

THE SCHOOL DISTRICT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CHANGE THE TIME AND/OR DATE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS. NOTICE OF ANY SUCH CHANGE SHALL BE PROVIDED NOT LESS THAN 48 HOURS PRIOR TO THE TIME SET FORTH ABOVE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS BY MEANS OF A SUPPLEMENTAL NOTICE OF SALE TO BE TRANSMITTED OVER THE MUNIFACTS WIRE.

Bonds maturing on or before June 15, 2005 are not subject to redemption prior to maturity. Bonds maturing on or after June 15, 2006 are subject to redemption, at the option of the School District, prior to maturity, in whole or in part, on any interest payment date on or after June 15, 2005 at a redemption prices, expressed as a percentage of par, plus accrued interest to the redemption date, as follows: June 15, 2005 and December 15, 2005, 102%, June 15, 2006 and December 15, 2006, 101%; and June 15, 2007 and thereafter, 100%.
The purchaser will be furnished without cost, the
unqualified legal opinion as to the validity of the Bonds of Mackenzie Smith Lewis Michell &Hughes, LLP, Syracuse, New York, Bond Counsel.

For further information regarding the Bonds and to obtain copies of the complete Notice of Bond Sale, bid form, and the Preliminary Official Statement of the School District, please contact Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc., telephone (315) 699-7912, telecopier (315) 699-8833. Additional
